//: Read by the CDK App that `defineBackend` creates, in the Amplify build and locally.
Step G pushed the data stack's CloudFormation template to 1,007,296 bytes and the
deploy was refused: 'Template may not exceed 1000000 bytes in size' (job 26).
Nearly a third of those bytes were the pretty-printer's indentation — CloudFormation
counts what is uploaded, not what is readable. Suppressing it leaves the same
resources and brings the template to 713,837 bytes.
This is headroom, not a cure: the data stack grows with every model and every Lambda
policy, and the next step that adds a table will need the real fix — splitting the
TMS Lambdas' grants out of the data stack, or a second data stack.
